audit.whatIsWrong: Rows 1, 2 and 4 disagreed with the packet chart (Renekton, Renekton, Skill, Ornn, Ornn, Ornn, Ornn) and with the page's own whys.
audit.why: whys[1] opens 'He still owns Level 2' while the chart rendered Skill; whys[2] says the W 'even[s] the lane' while the chart rendered Ornn; whys[4] says the double knock-up 'win[s] the all-in' while the chart rendered Renekton. All three whys already agreed with the 1976-game packet.
audit.corrected: Row 1 Skill -> Renekton (3/10), row 2 Ornn -> Skill (5/10), row 4 Renekton -> Ornn (6/10), in BOTH layers as one group.

audit.whatIsWrong: breakdown.spikes listed 'Ruthless Predator online, level 6, first item' — the real spike in this matchup is a resource threshold, not a level.
audit.why: Everything about Renekton's power is gated on 50 Fury: above it, Ruthless Predator goes from 0.75s to 1.5s stun and destroys shields, Cull the Meek's damage and heal increase, and Slice and Dice shreds armour. The Fury bar is the spike the player should be reading, and it was never mentioned. Dominus (120s at rank 1) also generates Fury periodically, so level 6 keeps him topped up.
audit.corrected: Spikes now lead with '50 Fury for the empowered combo' and name Dominus at 6 with its 120s cooldown.
sources: kit: Reign of Anger, Q/W/E empowered clauses, Dominus

audit.whatIsWrong: Packet defect: none of Renekton's abilities were named. The single most important clause in his kit never reached the page — empowered Ruthless Predator 'destroy[s] damage shields on the target'.
audit.why: Ornn's whole level-3 stabilisation is built on Bellows Breath's shield, and the page repeats 'shield' as the reason he survives the all-in. Renekton above 50 Fury deletes that shield outright and then stuns for 1.5 seconds instead of 0.75. A player who does not know this will hold W for the all-in and lose it. Also unstated: Reign of Anger generates Fury FASTER when he is low, so hurting him accelerates his empowerment; Cull the Meek is a flat 7s heal (the anti-heal target); Ruthless Predator is a 300-range auto-attack reset, so the wind-up is the tell; Slice and Dice is 450 range on 16s at rank 1 and shreds armour when empowered.
audit.corrected: All five named; the shield-destruction clause, both stun durations, the Fury threshold and the low-health Fury acceleration are now on the page with real cooldowns.

audit.whatIsWrong: breakdown.cooldowns said 'Empowered = long stun. Brittle-tank it.' with no durations at all.
audit.why: Ruthless Predator at 16s rank 1 dropping to 8s maxed changes the lane completely across levels; and Cull the Meek's flat 7s is the reason chip damage never sticks without Grievous Wounds.
audit.corrected: Cooldown block now carries Ruthless Predator 300/16s/8s with both stun values, Cull the Meek 7s flat, and Dominus 120s.

audit.whatIsWrong: dosFull[1].d and dontsFull[2].d were verbatim copies of tradeGood/tradeBad; dontsFull[0] is titled 'Trade into full fury' but never said what Fury does or how he gets it.
audit.why: The rule most likely to save the player a death was the one carrying template filler.
audit.corrected: Each rule now carries a distinct mechanic: the auto-reset tell, the low-health Fury acceleration, the shield destruction, and the anti-heal timing.

notes: The buried clause that matters most: empowered Ruthless Predator 'destroy[s] damage shields on the target'. Ornn's entire level-3 stabilisation on this page is described in terms of his shield, and above 50 Fury Renekton removes it before the 1.5s stun lands. That was nowhere on the page and is now in five places. Second useful find: Reign of Anger generates Fury faster when he is LOW, so chipping him into the empowered window is a live risk the player should know about. DELIBERATELY NOT ASSERTED: whether Bellows Breath actually grants Ornn a shield — the kit file's Riot text for it reads only 'Ornn advances, breathing fire. Enemies hit by the final gout of flame become Brittle', with no shield or unstoppable clause, yet the content layer asserts both across every matchup. I did not add or remove that claim here, but it is champion-level and worth verifying once for all of Ornn's pages; flagged in questionsForUser. Also not asserted: whether Ruthless Predator's stun is reduced by tenacity, and whether Slice and Dice's second dash can cross a magma pillar.
